Because the benchmarking source reports category-level TPC rather than a VRFB/Fe-Cr component split, the same CAPEX factor is applied to power and energy costs; fixed O&M follows the ESGC-derived VRFB trend.

2025-2030 source-anchored compound interpolation. v0.4 uses LDES Council/EPRI 2026 compressed-gas benchmarking rather than a flat ESGC CAES row. The report gives 2025-2030 Intraday Compressed Gas TPC reductions of 6-25%; the reference curve uses the midpoint reduction of 15.5% by 2030 and continues the same compound annual rate to 2035. Because the source reports total plant cost in $/kWh rather than a power/energy component split, the same CAPEX factor is applied to power_cost and energy_cost; fixed and variable O&M are kept at 1.0 unless separately evidenced. DOE 2024 Storage Innovations 2030 supports larger CAES innovation potential but is treated as supporting evidence, not directly converted to the reference CAPEX factor. Applied as compressed-gas proxy for liquid-air energy storage because the LDES Council/EPRI category includes advanced compressed air, liquid air, and CO2-based systems.
